name: Duel Commander
about: Commander for two players at 20 life, with its own ban list.

name: PreDH
about: Commander with older cards only – games like Commander used to play.

name: Premodern
about: Cards from the years before Modern's sets, up to four of each.

name: Penny Dreadful
about: Only the cheapest cards online, up to four of each – the list changes each season.

name: Historic
about: Arena's format with every card added to Arena, up to four of each.

name: Timeless
about: Arena's format with every card ever on Arena, a short ban list and restricted cards.
